matched_q8_reference.method: Original-Q8 trained spans restored SHA-exact; identical frozen decode geometry, compiler binary, kernels, supplied tokens and prepared embedding/ngram inputs. No historical-prefill geometry substitution.

screened_policy.method: In-corpus isolated-hop screen, not a holdout; combined policy is separately replayed.

attribution.method: Each single-rank policy compresses only that destination's work boundary; all other boundaries remain f32. Complete subsequent trained layers/state/head propagate the perturbation. Isolated KL values are not additive.

fp16.method: RTT/2 with real work encode/decode, framing, CRC and validation; not synchronized one-way timing
fp16.scope: Eight sequential work transfers only; unchanged output/head, prefill, MTP verification and other work excluded. Not measured serving TPS.

mixed_first_f32_model.method: Initial work remains f32; seven ordinary scaled-FP16 transfers. Modeled, not ring TPS.

mixed_no_rank0_model.method: Destination0 ordinary work remains f32; initial and six ordinary transfers scaled FP16. Modeled, not ring TPS.

mixed_screened_model.method: Same paired-round model for the replayed, in-corpus screened destination mask; not serving timing.

fp16-128.method: RTT/2 with real work encode/decode, framing, CRC and validation; not synchronized one-way timing
fp16-128.scope: Eight sequential work transfers only; unchanged output/head, prefill, MTP verification and other work excluded. Not measured serving TPS.
